# ChirpStack event fixtures

JSON examples from the ChirpStack v4 documentation, https://www.chirpstack.io/docs/chirpstack/integrations/events.html (fetched 2026-09-03), with a second gateway reception added to `up.json`. Recorded events from a real ChirpStack instance are added next to them as they come in, each with a note of its origin.

`up_opencollar_status_live.json`: the first recorded live event, an OpenCollar Edge status uplink (port 4) of device SP051307 (DevEUI 0016C001F01192A0, firmware 7.2, hardware 1.8) received on 2026-09-05 10:56:43 UTC by chirpstack-dev4.smartparks.org through its HTTP integration, with ChirpStack's own decoder output in `object` for comparison. Uptime is days since boot in the firmware (the research document, section on port 4), which the driver reports in seconds.

`up_mesh_relayed_live.json`: an uplink a Gateway Mesh relay heard, recorded on 2026-11-18 05:54:50 UTC from the ChirpStack of a Smart Parks deployment with border and relay gateways (decision D398). Relay f136fd99 heard the device and two border gateways forwarded it, so `rxInfo` has two entries with the border as `gatewayId`, the relay in `metadata.relay_id`, `metadata.hop_count` and the relay's RSSI and SNR on both. The `rxInfo` and `txInfo` are as recorded, except that the borders' coordinates are replaced; the device (DevEUI, name, application) is replaced, and ChirpStack's decoded `object` with the animal's position is left out. A two-hop entry recorded on the same server differs only in `"hop_count": "2"`.
